title: Code of Criminal Procedure Amendment Act 1993

sections.shortTitle: Code of Criminal Procedure Amendment Act 1993
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT VIII OF 1993
ACT VIII OF 1993
CODE OF CRIMINAL
PROCEDURE (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1993
An Act further to
amend the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898
(Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 5th April, 1993)
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 4th
April, 1993 and is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the Code of Criminal Procedure
(Amendment) Act, 1993.
(2) It shall come into force on
such date as the Federal Government may by notification in the official
Gazette, appoint.

sections.shortTitle: Code of Criminal Procedure Amendment Act 1993
sections.description:
Amendment of section 58, Act V of 1898

ACT VIII OF 1993
ACT VIII OF 1993
CODE OF CRIMINAL
PROCEDURE (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1993
An Act further to
amend the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898
(Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 5th April, 1993)
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 4th
April, 1993 and is hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 58,
Act V of 1898:---In the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 (Act V of 1898),
hereinafter referred to as the said Code, in section 58, the following
Explanation shall be added at the end, namely:--
"Explanation.--In this
section, "police-officer" includes a police-officer acting under this
Code as in force in Azad Jammu and Kashmir.".
